description: Closed Beta Usability Evaluation with Journalists and Fact-Checkers

participants.name: Ananya Sharma
participants.primary_concern: Avoiding false accusations based on opaque AI verdicts; verifying media leaks.

participants.name: Marcus Vance
participants.primary_concern: Calibrated uncertainty, distinguishing AI-generated images from genuine documentary photos, understanding model degradation.

participants.name: Elena Rostova
participants.primary_concern: Perceptual hash near-duplicate detection, on-chain cryptographic audit trail, client-side media privacy.

scenarios.title: Clear Synthetic Assessment
scenarios.expected_action: Treat as automated high-likelihood synthetic indicator; cite calibrated probability; do NOT present as incontrovertible legal proof without corroborating OSINT.

scenarios.title: Clear Authentic Assessment
scenarios.expected_action: Recognize that 'authentic' indicates absence of synthetic generator signatures under Model A/B; does not preclude manual digital manipulation or staged reality.

scenarios.title: Boundary Ambiguity (Conformal ABSTAIN)
scenarios.expected_action: Recognize that the engine explicitly refused to produce a confident binary label; withhold publication of authenticity claim until manual forensic review.

scenarios.title: Out-of-Distribution Media (Mahalanobis ABSTAIN)
scenarios.expected_action: Understand that the image format/domain lies outside model calibration bounds (e.g., thermal, infrared, or synthetic artwork); engine safely abstains.

scenarios.title: Ensemble Disagreement ABSTAIN
scenarios.state: ACTIVE / ABSTAIN (Model A: 78.4% vs Model B: 31.2%)
scenarios.expected_action: Note that independent model architectures disagree; treat assessment as inconclusive; inspect individual model logits on details page.

scenarios.title: Model Canary Degradation (STALE Warning)
scenarios.expected_action: Acknowledge the STALE badge; do not rely on verdict for breaking publication; request model re-evaluation or wait for superseded attestation.

scenarios.title: Active Challenge in Progress (CHALLENGED)
scenarios.state: CHALLENGED / Dispute filed on Base Sepolia
scenarios.expected_action: Recognize that the verdict is under formal algorithmic challenge by an independent verifier; flag story with 'disputed authenticity record'.

scenarios.title: Slashing & Invalidation (UPHELD_CHALLENGE)
scenarios.expected_action: Disregard original attestation; recognize that attester was found in breach of deterministic execution; issue retraction or update.

scenarios.title: Un-attested Media (No on-chain record)
scenarios.state: LOCAL HASH ONLY / No on-chain records found
scenarios.expected_action: Correctly interpret that 'no verdict found' is NOT proof of authenticity; use local evaluation or submit for attestation.

scenarios.title: Perceptual Near-Duplicate Match (pHash <= 10)
scenarios.expected_action: Understand that the image is a recompressed or resized variant of an attested image; inspect matched attestation while noting file differences.

key_findings: All evaluators unanimously understood that PRAMANA provides model-assessed probabilities rather than absolute truth.
The 'ABSTAIN' status badge was praised for eliminating false certainty on boundary and OOD media.
Client-side WASM fingerprinting was cited by investigative journalists as essential for confidential source protection.
Evaluator P3 noted that STALE badges effectively communicated when older verdicts should not be trusted for current reporting.
